gloss: one night and two days; overnight trip

definitions.gloss: one night and two days; overnight trip
definitions.explanation: A trip or stay lasting one night and spanning two calendar days. The standard way to describe a short overnight trip in Japanese travel planning.

examples.japanese: {一泊二日|いっぱくふつか}で{温泉|おんせん}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to a hot spring for an overnight trip.

examples.japanese: {一泊二日|いっぱくふつか}の{社員旅行|しゃいんりょこう}が{計画|けいかく}されている。
examples.english: An overnight company trip is being planned.

examples.japanese: {京都|きょうと}{一泊二日|いっぱくふつか}のプランを{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a one-night Kyoto trip plan.

examples.japanese: {一泊二日|いっぱくふつか}では{時間|じかん}が{足|た}りないので、{二泊三日|にはくみっか}にしよう。
examples.english: One night isn't enough time, so let's make it two nights.

notes:
An extremely common expression in Japanese travel culture. Japan's domestic travel industry structures packages and plans around this counting system: ○泊○日 (○ nights ○ days). The pattern extends naturally: 二泊三日 (2 nights 3 days), 三泊四日, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一泊二日|いっぱくふつか}の{旅行|りょこう}: overnight trip
- {一泊二日|いっぱくふつか}プラン: overnight plan/package
- {一泊二日|いっぱくふつか}で: for one night (duration)
- {一泊二日|いっぱくふつか}{二食付|にしょくつ}き: one night with two meals included

RELATED WORDS:
- {二泊三日|にはくみっか}: two nights three days
- {日帰|ひがえ}り: day trip (no overnight stay)
- {連泊|れんぱく}: consecutive nights' stay
